$comment: 语法大厅 G13（V0.9 P2a 样课，骨架层首课）。比喻与 KET 八课 L3 字面一致：中文动词是没日期的照片，英文动词自带日期戳。40 不规则动词沿用六组分形状记法（接 data/exam/ket/irregular-verbs.json，不按字母表排）。暗线主打：越常用的词，越不规则。全部内容原创。
title: 一般过去时与 40 个不规则动词
metaphor: 中文动词是没日期的照片，英文动词自带日期戳
ketNote: 过去式盖戳是 KET Part 7 看图写故事的第一评分点；不规则动词写没写对，直接决定 Part 5 和写作的印象分。八课里的亲戚是 L3。

sections.essence: 中文动词是没日期的照片，英文动词自带日期戳：昨天的事，动词自己变形报时。
sections.why: 中文的动词像一张没有日期的照片：「我昨天吃面」「我明天吃面」——「吃」永远不变，时间写在旁边的便签（昨天／明天）上。英文正相反：日期戳直接刻在动词身上，play 是今天的，played 是昨天的——戳一盖上，便签 yesterday 反而可以不要。大部分动词乖乖盖 -ed 公章；可英语里最有用的那 40 个动词偏偏不用公章，各留各的老印章：go→went、eat→ate、see→saw。所以中国孩子讲昨天的事，最容易「便签写着昨天，照片却盖着今天的戳」——这正是 KET 写作里最扣分的毛病。
sections.metaphorStory: 银帆乐团有一本排练日志，专门记「已经发生的事」。管日志的乐务老师有一枚 -ed 日期戳：练完琴，play 盖成 played；看完演出，watch 盖成 watched——词尾一看，就知道这件事翻篇了。可乐团里有四十位老团员，资历比这枚公章还老：公章发明前他们就入团了，早刻好了自家的私章。老师举着公章过去，他们把手一挡：「我有自己的章。」go 的私章是 went，eat 的是 ate，see 的是 saw。好在私章不是乱刻的，凑近看能认出六种形状：有的干脆不变（put→put），有的换个元音（sing→sang），有一家子全姓 -ought（buy→bought），有的尾巴利落收个 t（sleep→slept），有的被风吹成 -ew（know→knew），剩下的各走各路，是独行侠（go→went）。记形状，别背字母表。

cards.detail: 昨天、上周、去年发生完的事，动词词尾盖 -ed。

cards.rule: -ed 公章的三条拼写小规则
cards.detail: 以 e 结尾只加 d；辅音+y 变 i 加 ed；短元音+单辅音先双写再加 ed。
清音后读 /t/，浊音后读 /d/，t 和 d 后面读 /ɪd/——读出来能帮你记住写法。

cards.rule: 40 位老团员：六组私章，按形状记
cards.detail: 🪨完全不变（put→put）· 🔄换元音 i→a（sing→sang）· 🎣-ought 一家（buy→bought）· ✂️尾巴变 t（sleep→slept）· 🌬️风吹 -ew（know→knew）· 🤠独行侠（go→went）。一天一组，第七天混起来抽查——别按字母表背。
cards.example: cut→cut / swim→swam / think→thought / feel→felt / fly→flew / eat→ate

cards.detail: yesterday / last week / two days ago → 过去；every day / usually / often → 现在。先看信号词定调，再选动词形状。
cards.example: Last night we watched the stars. / I water the plants every day.

cards.rule: did 一出场，时间戳只盖一次
cards.detail: 疑问和否定交给 did / didn't 之后，动词回到原形——这是 G12 那只手势的规矩。
cards.example: Did you go there? / I didn't go.（不说 Did you went）

basic.en: I played basketball after school yesterday.
basic.cn: 昨天放学后我打了篮球。（play 盖上 -ed 戳）

basic.en: She watched a cartoon last night.
We visited the science museum last month.
basic.cn: 上个月我们参观了科技馆。

basic.en: My family went to the park last Sunday.
basic.cn: 上周日我们全家去了公园。（go 用私章 went）

basic.en: Grandma told me a funny story last night.
basic.cn: 昨晚奶奶给我讲了个好笑的故事。（tell→told）

mid.en: The show began at half past seven.
mid.cn: 演出七点半开始了。（begin→began，i 变 a）

mid.en: I lost my gloves on the way to school.
mid.cn: 上学路上我把手套弄丢了。（lose→lost）

mid.en: He caught the ball with one hand.
mid.cn: 他单手接住了球。（catch→caught，-ought 一家）

mid.en: We flew to Kunming for the holiday.
She kept the ticket in her pocket.
mid.cn: 她把票收在口袋里。（keep→kept，尾巴变 t）

trap.en: Yesterday I read a storybook in bed.
trap.cn: 昨天我躺在床上读了本故事书。
trap.note: read 的过去式拼写完全不变，只有读音变 /red/——写出来看不出，读出来才暴露时态。

trap.en: I studied for the test and then stopped to rest.
trap.cn: 我复习完考试内容，然后停下来休息。
trap.note: study 辅音+y 变 i 加 ed；stop 短元音+单辅音要双写——两条拼写小规则同框。

trap.en: Did you take any photos at the zoo?
trap.note: did 已经盖了戳——take 回原形，时间戳只盖一次。

trap.en: He didn't say a word all morning.
trap.cn: 他一上午一句话都没说。
trap.note: didn't 后动词回原形 say，不说 didn't said。

trap.en: We put the chairs away after class yesterday.
trap.cn: 昨天下课后我们把椅子收好了。
trap.note: put 是完全不变组——全靠 yesterday 才知道是过去的事。

trap.en: My mum cut the cake into eight pieces just now.
trap.cn: 妈妈刚把蛋糕切成了八块。
trap.note: cut 也完全不变——「不变」本身就是它的私章。

redBlack.bad: I'm sorry — I break your cup.
redBlack.good: I'm sorry — I broke your cup.
redBlack.why: 不盖戳，听的人以为你「老是打碎杯子」甚至「打算打碎」——刚才发生的事说不清了。

redBlack.bad: We meet at the school gate at three.（想说：昨天三点见过了）
redBlack.good: We met at the school gate at three.
redBlack.why: meet 不变形就成了「三点见」的约定——到底见过了还是要去见，意思全反。

redBlack.bad: He goed to bed very late last night.
redBlack.good: He went to bed very late last night.
redBlack.why: go 是独行侠，不盖 -ed 公章——它的私章是借来的 went。

redBlack.bad: She wented home after the show.
redBlack.good: She went home after the show.
redBlack.why: went 已经是过去式了，再加 -ed 是盖两次戳。

redBlack.bad: I buyed some fruit for grandma.
redBlack.good: I bought some fruit for grandma.

redBlack.why: run 换元音 u→a 变 ran，不双写也不加 -ed。

redBlack.bad: Did you watched the match last night?
redBlack.good: Did you watch the match last night?
redBlack.why: did 已经盖了戳——watch 回原形，时间戳只盖一次。

redBlack.bad: They didn't went out because of the rain.
redBlack.good: They didn't go out because of the rain.
redBlack.why: didn't 后动词回原形 go——两个人抢着报时就乱了。

redBlack.bad: I seed a shooting star last night.
redBlack.good: I saw a shooting star last night.

redBlack.bad: He standed there for an hour.
redBlack.good: He stood there for an hour.
redBlack.why: stand 的私章是 stood——不盖 -ed。

redBlack.bad: I dreamed a strange dream last night.（有人说必须写 dreamt）
redBlack.why: 少数动词两种过去式并存（美式 dreamed / 英式 dreamt），KET 不设这个坑。

redBlack.bad: Yesterday night I heard a strange sound.
redBlack.good: Last night I heard a strange sound.
redBlack.why: yesterday night 不地道但意思不挡——地道说法是 last night。

contrast.cn: 我昨天吃面。（「吃」不变，时间在便签上）
contrast.en: I ate noodles yesterday.（eat 变 ate，自己报时）
contrast.diff: 中文动词是没日期的照片；英文的日期戳直接刻在动词身上。

contrast.cn: 吃了饭再走。（「了」却说的是将来）
contrast.en: 过去就 ate，将来就 will eat
contrast.diff: 中文的「了」表「完成」不表「过去」；英语的过去式只认时间——别把「了」自动翻成过去式。
中文动词从不变形；英文一个动词好几副面孔，各管各的时间。

contrast.cn: 你昨天去了吗？（动词照旧）
contrast.en: Did you go there yesterday?（did 接管时间戳，go 回原形）
contrast.diff: 中文提问动词不动；英语把时间戳交给 did，动词退回原形。

contrast.cn: 讲故事不用管每个动词的时间
contrast.en: 英语一段话里每个动词各自盖戳
contrast.diff: 中文靠上下文定时间；英语每个动词都要自己报时，一个漏盖就是病句。

quickJudge.mnemonic: 先找信号词定调；昨天的事必盖戳；盖章前先问——是不是老团员？
steps: 找信号词：yesterday / last... / ...ago → 过去；every day / usually / often → 现在。
定了过去 → 句子里每个动词都要盖过去戳，一个都不能漏。
规则动词盖 -ed 公章，过一遍拼写三小规则（e 结尾只加 d / y 变 i / 短元音双写）。
是 40 位老团员？换他们的私章——先认形状：不变 / i→a / -ought / 变 t / -ew / 独行侠。
句子里有 did / didn't？时间戳已被它盖走——动词回原形。

parentScript.script: 「宝贝，中文的动词像没日期的照片：『我昨天吃面』的『吃』和今天的『吃』一模一样。英语的动词自己带日期戳：今天 play，昨天就变 played；今天 eat，昨天就变 ate。咱们晚饭玩『昨天今天』：你先用英语说一件今天常做的事，再把同一件事说成昨天做过的——我不懂英语没关系，我只听动词变没变。」孩子说对了可以加码：故意说「我昨天 go 公园」让她抓错——go 是有自己私章的老团员，昨天要说 went。听到她给 go、eat 这些词硬加 -ed（goed、eated），就喊「老团员不用公章」。
questions: 「我昨天吃面」的「吃」变了吗？英语的 eat 到了昨天要变成什么？
played 尾巴上的 -ed 是干什么用的？是不是所有动词都乖乖加 -ed？
Did you go to the park? 里的 go 为什么不用变成 went？

sections.echo: 英语里最常用的 40 个动词，恰好就是那 40 个不规则动词——这不是巧合。-ed 公章是后来才推行的「新章」：冷门动词没人天天用，旧形态早被人忘了，只好乖乖改用新章；而 go、eat、see 天天挂在嘴边，旧印章每天被盖一遍，根本轮不到被规则化。最极端的是 went：它本来是另一个动词 wend（缓缓而行）的过去式，被 go 借来就没还——最常用的 go，连过去式都是借的。越常用的词，越不规则。所以你背的不是 40 个例外，是同一条规律被说了 40 遍。

memoryCard.alt: G13 记忆卡：英文动词自带日期戳；规则动词盖 -ed 公章（含三条拼写规则与三种读音）；40 个不规则动词按六组形状记（完全不变/i变a/-ought/尾巴变t/-ew/独行侠）；警示 goed、buyed、Did you went 三类错误。

stages.name: 认一认 · 信号词与私章

questions.q: yesterday 是哪一天的信号词？
questions.explain: yesterday＝昨天——动词要盖过去戳。

questions.q: every day 提示动词用什么调？
questions.explain: 每天都发生的习惯——一般现在。

questions.q: last week 后面的动词要怎么办？
questions.explain: 上周的事已经发生完——盖过去戳。

questions.q: two days ago 是什么信号？
questions.explain: …ago＝…之前——过去。

questions.q: usually 提示句子讲的是？
questions.explain: usually＝通常——一般现在说习惯。

questions.q: play 盖过去戳变成？
questions.explain: 规则动词直接盖 -ed 公章。

questions.q: watch 盖过去戳变成？
questions.explain: 规则动词——watched。

questions.q: go 的过去式是？
questions.explain: 独行侠 go 的私章是借来的 went。

questions.q: eat 的过去式是？
questions.explain: 独行侠——ate。

questions.q: see 的过去式是？
questions.explain: 独行侠——saw。

questions.q: put 的过去式是？
questions.explain: 完全不变组——put 的私章就是「不变」。

questions.q: sing 的过去式是？
questions.explain: 换元音组：肚子里的 i 变 a——sang。

questions.q: buy 的过去式是？
questions.explain: -ought 一家——bought。

questions.q: sleep 的过去式是？
questions.explain: 尾巴变 t 组——slept。

questions.q: know 的过去式是？
questions.explain: 风吹 -ew 组——knew。

questions.q: read 的过去式怎么变？
questions.explain: 完全不变组里最狡猾的一个：写出来一样，读出来才露馅。

stages.name: 选一选 · 盖对日期戳

questions.q: We ___ football in the park yesterday.
questions.explain: yesterday 定调过去——play 盖 -ed 戳。

questions.q: She ___ a new dress last Saturday.
questions.explain: buy 是 -ought 一家——bought。

questions.q: I ___ up at six this morning.（现在已经是晚上）
questions.explain: 今天早上已经过去——get→got。

questions.q: They ___ to the beach last summer.
questions.explain: last summer 定调过去——went。

questions.q: He ___ two bowls of noodles last night.
questions.explain: eat 是独行侠——ate。

questions.q: My grandpa ___ me a kite two days ago.
questions.explain: make→made——独行侠组。

questions.q: We ___ a lion at the zoo last Sunday.
questions.explain: see→saw。

questions.q: The baby ___ for ten hours last night.
questions.explain: sleep 尾巴变 t——slept。

questions.q: Tom ___ his schoolbag on the bus yesterday.
questions.explain: leave 尾巴变 t（还剪短了元音）——left。

questions.q: I ___ a picture of my pet in art class yesterday.
questions.explain: draw 被风吹成 -ew——drew。

questions.q: The film ___ at seven and ended at nine.
questions.explain: begin 换元音 i→a——began；后面的 ended 已经盖好戳提示你了。

questions.q: He ___ his grandma a long letter last month.
questions.explain: write→wrote——独行侠。

questions.q: The leaves ___ down in the wind yesterday.
questions.explain: fall→fell。

questions.q: She ___ her ticket on the way home and cried.
questions.explain: lose 尾巴变 t——lost。

questions.q: stop 盖过去戳要怎么写？
questions.explain: 短元音+单辅音先双写再加 -ed——stopped。

questions.q: study 盖过去戳要怎么写？
questions.explain: 辅音+y 变 i 加 ed——studied。

questions.q: 哪一句的日期戳盖对了？（昨天去游泳）
options: We swam in the river yesterday.
We swimmed in the river yesterday.
We swim in the river yesterday.
questions.explain: swim 换元音 i→a——swam；swimmed 是假章。

questions.q: 哪一句的日期戳盖对了？（上周买了礼物）
options: She bought a gift for me last week.
She buyed a gift for me last week.
She buys a gift for me last week.
questions.explain: -ought 一家——bought。

questions.q: 哪一句的日期戳盖对了？（昨晚跑回家）
options: He ran home in the rain last night.
He runned home in the rain last night.
He runs home in the rain last night.
questions.explain: run→ran，不双写不加 -ed。

questions.q: 哪一句的问句没抢戳？（刚才看到彩虹了吗）
options: Did you see the rainbow just now?
Did you saw the rainbow just now?
Do you saw the rainbow just now?
questions.explain: did 已盖戳——see 回原形，时间戳只盖一次。

questions.q: 哪一句的否定没抢戳？（昨晚没听见电话）
options: I didn't hear the phone last night.
I didn't heard the phone last night.
I don't heard the phone last night.
questions.explain: didn't 后动词回原形 hear。

questions.q: 哪一句的日期戳盖对了？（昨天从自行车上摔下来）
options: She fell off her bike yesterday.
She falled off her bike yesterday.
She fells off her bike yesterday.
questions.explain: fall→fell——独行侠。

questions.q: 哪一句的日期戳盖对了？（上周教我们新歌）
options: They taught us a new song last week.
They teached us a new song last week.
They teach us a new song last week.
questions.explain: teach 是 -aught 形——taught。

questions.q: 哪一句的日期戳盖对了？（今早在课桌下发现硬币）
options: I found a coin under my desk this morning.
I finded a coin under my desk this morning.
I find a coin under my desk this morning.
questions.explain: find→found。

questions.q: 哪一句的日期戳盖对了？（球扔太远了）
options: He threw the ball too far.
He throwed the ball too far.
He throws the ball too far just now.
questions.explain: throw 被风吹成 threw。

questions.q: 哪一句的日期戳盖对了？（聚会上喝光了果汁）
options: We drank all the juice at the party.
We drinked all the juice at the party.
We drink all the juice at the party yesterday.
questions.explain: drink 换元音 i→a——drank。

questions.q: 哪一句的日期戳盖对了？（上周一飞去上海）
options: My uncle flew to Shanghai last Monday.
My uncle flied to Shanghai last Monday.
My uncle flys to Shanghai last Monday.
questions.explain: fly→flew——风吹 -ew 组。

questions.q: 哪一句的日期戳盖对了？（这座桥 2018 年建的）
options: The workers built this bridge in 2018.
The workers builded this bridge in 2018.
The workers build this bridge in 2018.
questions.explain: build 尾巴变 t——built；in 2018 是过去信号。

questions.q: 哪一句的日期戳盖对了？（昨天做饭切到手指）
options: I cut my finger while cooking yesterday.
I cutted my finger while cooking yesterday.
I cuts my finger while cooking yesterday.
questions.explain: cut 完全不变——cutted 是假章。

questions.q: 哪一句的日期戳盖对了？（说了对不起就走了）
options: She said sorry and went away.
She sayed sorry and wented away.
She said sorry and goed away.
questions.explain: say→said、go→went——一句里两个动词各盖各的私章。

questions.q: 哪一句的问句盖对了？（昨天谁赢了比赛）
questions.explain: win→won；问「谁做了」时动词自己带戳，不请 did。

questions.q: 哪一句的日期戳盖对了？（在湖里钓到大鱼）
options: He caught a big fish in the lake.
He catched a big fish in the lake.
He catchs a big fish in the lake.
questions.explain: catch 是 -aught 形——caught。

questions.q: She usually ___ to school on foot, but this morning she ___ a taxi.
questions.explain: usually 配现在 walks；this morning（已过去）配 took——一句里两个信号词、两种时态。

questions.q: I ___ milk every day, but yesterday I ___ juice.
questions.explain: 习惯用 drink；昨天盖戳 drank。

questions.q: Last night I ___ my homework, ___ a shower and went to bed.
questions.explain: 一段过去的事，每个动词都盖戳：did、took、went。

questions.q: — ___ you ___ the concert last night? — Yes, it was wonderful.
questions.explain: did 举手后 enjoy 回原形——时间戳只盖一次。

questions.q: The sun ___ in the east — that never changes.
questions.explain: 永远为真的事实用一般现在——rises（三单加 s）。

questions.q: We ___ dumplings and then ___ home last night.
questions.explain: 两个动作都发生完了——ate、went，各用各的私章。

questions.q: She ___ me an email two days ago, but I ___ it only this morning.
questions.explain: send→sent；read 过去式拼写不变（读 /red/）。

questions.q: My dad ___ in a bank now. He ___ working there ten years ago.
questions.explain: now 配现在 works；ten years ago 配过去 began。

questions.q: I ___ my grandma every weekend. Last weekend I also ___ her a cake.
questions.explain: 每周的习惯用 visit（I 不加 s）；上周末的事用 brought（-ought 一家）。

questions.q: — What ___ you ___ last Sunday? — I flew my new kite.
questions.explain: What did you do?——前一个 did 是手势，后一个 do 是实义动词「做」，回原形。

questions.q: He ___ the race because he ___ faster than everyone.
questions.explain: win→won、run→ran——两个私章都要认对。

questions.q: When I was small, my mum ___ me a story every night.
questions.explain: when I was small 把整句拉回过去——过去的习惯也盖过去戳：told。

questions.q: Water ___ at 100 degrees, but yesterday our kettle ___ down.
questions.explain: 事实用现在 boils；昨天坏了用 broke。

questions.q: I ___ my umbrella at home this morning, so I ___ wet now.
questions.explain: 早上落下伞是过去 left；现在浑身湿是现在 am——前因过去，后果现在。

questions.q: First he ___ up, then he ___ his teeth and ran to school.
questions.explain: get→got（私章）；brush→brushed（公章）；ran 已提示整句在过去。

questions.q: 大考：Yesterday was busy — I ___ a letter, ___ some photos and ___ dinner.
questions.explain: 三个动词三枚私章一次盖齐：wrote、took、made——一个都不能漏。

detective.sentence: I go to the zoo with my cousin yesterday.
detective.fixed: I went to the zoo with my cousin yesterday.
detective.clue: 便签写着 yesterday，照片却盖着今天的戳——go 要换成私章 went。

detective.sentence: She buyed a pretty hair clip at the market.
detective.fixed: She bought a pretty hair clip at the market.
detective.clue: buy 是 -ought 一家的老团员，不盖 -ed 公章。

detective.sentence: We eated pizza at Tom's birthday party.
detective.fixed: We ate pizza at Tom's birthday party.
detective.clue: eat 是独行侠——它的私章是 ate，eated 是假章。

detective.sentence: Did you finished your homework last night?
detective.fixed: Did you finish your homework last night?
detective.clue: did 已经盖了戳——finish 回原形，时间戳只盖一次。

detective.sentence: He teached us an English song last term.
detective.fixed: He taught us an English song last term.
detective.clue: teach 是 -aught 形的老团员——taught。

detective.sentence: I stoped at the red light and waited.
detective.fixed: I stopped at the red light and waited.
detective.clue: stop 短元音+单辅音，先双写 p 再加 -ed——waited 没病，别多改。

detective.sentence: They didn't came to the rehearsal last Friday.
detective.fixed: They didn't come to the rehearsal last Friday.
detective.clue: didn't 已经报了过去——came 要退回原形 come。
